annotations.title: Check a saved commute for a travel date

description: Checks a saved train route against National Rail’s running records for one travel date and works out Delay Repay: the matched train, the delay, the amount, the deadline and a claim pack. When several trains match, the result lists them, each with a service_id. A saved route does not show that the person travelled that day, and the result says so. Nothing is saved or filed. Requires sign-in to Untap.

commute_id.description: The id of a saved commute.

date.description: The travel date to check, preferably YYYY-MM-DD. "yesterday" also works.

service_id.description: The service_id of a train listed in an earlier result. With it, that train is checked directly.

name: check_commute
title: Check a saved commute for a travel date
